items.name: Nacken's Fiddle-String
items.lore: A single string of silver hair. Pluck it and someone, somewhere, starts to dance.

items.name: Black-Pool Ring
items.lore: Jet from the bottom of the nacken's pool. It is always faintly damp.

items.name: Fiddler's Bow-Bracer
items.lore: A strip of horsehair and pine, worn on the wrist the way Eilif wears his.

items.name: Dancing-Green Sash
items.lore: Green silk, the kind worn at midsummer dances.

items.name: Hild's Rune-Stave Charm
items.lore: A splinter of a gotawitch's stave, its blood-runes sanded off. One rune stayed. It means 'sorry'.

items.name: Seeress' Veil
items.lore: A grey veil, worn by the seers of Gotar when they read the threads.

items.name: Unbranded Bracer
items.lore: A plain leather bracer. Hild wears its twin, over the place a brand would have been.

items.name: Flayer's Hook-Ring
items.lore: A troll-flayer's ring, hooked like a skinning knife.

items.name: Nipper-Tooth Ring
items.lore: A ring of wolf-pup teeth. Fort Atla's soldiers wear them for luck.

items.name: Lakeshore Belt
items.lore: Fish-leather, very supple.

items.name: Fish-Catcher's Net Charm
items.lore: A knot of hobgoblin net. Lucky, they say.

items.name: Fort Atla Gate Bracer
items.lore: Iron, the fort's mark on it.

items.name: Wildling's Bone Torc
items.lore: Bone and sinew, wildling-work.

items.name: Lake-Hunter's Mantle
items.lore: Reed-grey, for lying still by the water.

items.name: Drowned Bell Charm
items.lore: A ship's bell no bigger than a thumb. It rings by itself at night.

items.name: Salt-Stiff Belt
items.lore: Cut from the ship's rigging.

items.name: Oarsman's Grip Bracer
items.lore: Worn smooth by a dead man's rowing.

items.name: Ship-Wreck Ring
items.lore: Green bronze, from the ship's fittings.

items.name: Scale-Cargo Pendant
items.lore: A red scale, hot to the touch, on a ship's chain.

items.name: Svartalf Outcast's Ring
items.lore: Black iron, filed thin.

items.name: Trade-Road Cloak
items.lore: Road-dust grey, with deep pockets.

items.name: Scale-Trader's Ledger Charm
items.lore: A page of the ledger, folded small. The numbers are all in gold.

items.name: Runecaster's Stave-Belt
items.lore: A belt hung with little rune-staves.

items.name: Preacher's Scale Torc
items.lore: Dragon-scale on red cord. It's warm.

items.name: Nalliten Rune-Ward Bracer
items.lore: Carved with Runa's ward-runes.

items.name: Unburnt Mantle
items.lore: It doesn't scorch, even in the preacher's fire.

items.name: Wind-Host Feather Charm
items.lore: A grey feather that won't lie still.

items.name: Earth-Host Stone Ring
items.lore: A ring of plain stone, very heavy.

items.name: Pook-Trick Ring
items.lore: It turns on your finger when you're not looking.

items.name: Coast-Walker's Belt
items.lore: Crab-shell plates on sealskin.

items.name: Carrion-Bane Bracer
items.lore: Iron studs, for knocking carrion-eaters off.

items.name: Warm-Earth Pendant
items.lore: A stone from the vale. It's warm in your hand.

items.name: Envy-Scale Ring
items.lore: A drakeling's scale, green-gold.

items.name: Drake-Hunter's Mantle
items.lore: Scorched at the hem.

items.name: Gotawitch's Bone Charm
items.lore: Knucklebones on a thong. They click when trouble's coming.

items.name: Seith-Breaker's Bracer
items.lore: Rowan and silver.

items.name: Circle-Stone Ring
items.lore: A ring cut from the circle's stone.
